title: On the totally acyclic condition and the Auslander-Reiten Conjecture
summary: We prove new cases of the Auslander-Reiten conjecture under the assumption that the base ring satisfies the totally acyclic condition $(\mathbf{tac})$. A consequence of our work is that Auslander-Reiten conjecture holds in the graded setting whenever $R$ is Gorenstein and reduced. We also give an example of a local ring $R$ which does not satisfy $(\mathbf{tac})$ but for which the condition $\operatorname{Ext}^{i>0}_R(M,R)=0$ implies $M$ is totally reflexive for any finitely generated $R$-module $M$.
